output.summary: Annual flowering herb native to the Palaearctic. Its small yellow flower heads usually lack ray florets, with the disc florets mostly hidden by black-tipped bracts. It thrives in disturbed ground and reseeds from downy seeds that become sticky when wet.
output.edibilityNote: Reported as poisonous to humans; chronic exposure to its pyrrolizidine alkaloids can cause irreversible liver damage.
